# Sutando runs on the Mac


By OpenTools Team


·


November 4, 2026


Remote rooms retain local execution.


##


Runtime


Current S.space docs place Sutando inside the S app on its owner’s Mac, using that person’s Claude Code or Codex subscription. Selecting Sutando in a browser hands setup back to the desktop app.[1](https://docs.s.space/)


##


Access


The iPhone app opens the same rooms and messages; Sutando stays on the Mac. Agents connected from other apps run in those apps. Shared conversation access, agent execution and model entitlement remain separate dependencies.[1](https://docs.s.space/)
